be accessible to the public: The old castle used to be private, but now it is accessible to the public every weekend.
這座古堡以前是私人的，但現在每個週末都對大眾開放。
wheelchair accessible: The new library is fully wheelchair accessible, with ramps and wide elevators on every floor.
新圖書館完全無障礙，每層樓都有坡道和寬敞的電梯，輪椅可以通行。
make education accessible to all: The government hopes free online classes will make education accessible to all, including children in poor areas.
政府希望免費的線上課程能讓所有人都能受教育，包括貧困地區的孩子。
written in an accessible style: The science book is written in an accessible style, so even junior high students can understand it easily.
這本科學書以淺顯易懂的風格寫成，所以連國中生都能輕鬆理解。
accidental damage: Our phone insurance covers accidental damage, so we got a new screen for free after my sister dropped it.
我們的手機保險涵蓋意外損壞，所以妹妹摔壞手機後，我們免費換了新螢幕。
an accidental discovery: Penicillin was an accidental discovery made when a scientist noticed mold killing bacteria in his lab.
盤尼西林是個偶然的發現，當時一位科學家注意到實驗室裡的黴菌殺死了細菌。
accidental death: The police decided that the climber's fall was an accidental death and that no one else was involved.
警方判定那位登山客的墜落屬於意外死亡，沒有其他人涉入。
an accurate description: The witness gave the police an accurate description of the thief, and he was caught the next day.
目擊者向警方提供了竊賊的準確描述，他隔天就被抓到了。
accurate to within a millimeter: This new measuring tool is accurate to within a millimeter, so the builders can trust its results.
這個新的測量工具誤差在一毫米內，所以建築工人可以信賴它的結果。
an accurate shot: With an accurate shot from the middle of the field, the striker scored the winning goal in the last minute.
前鋒在最後一分鐘從球場中央準確一擊，踢進了致勝的一球。
an acid remark: She made an acid remark about my new haircut, and I felt hurt for the rest of the day.
她對我的新髮型發表了尖酸的評論，讓我一整天都很受傷。
acid rain: Pollution from factories can cause acid rain, which harms forests, lakes, and even old stone buildings.
工廠排放的污染會造成酸雨，損害森林、湖泊，甚至古老的石造建築。
an acid test: The final exam will be an acid test of whether the new teaching method really works.
期末考將是一場嚴峻的考驗，看看這種新教學法是否真的有效。
an acid tongue: My aunt has an acid tongue, so nobody at the dinner table wants to disagree with her.
我阿姨說話刻薄，所以餐桌上沒有人想跟她唱反調。
an acute shortage of food: After the long drought, the area faced an acute shortage of food, and many families went hungry.
長期乾旱之後，該地區面臨食物嚴重短缺，許多家庭挨餓。
acute pain: He felt acute pain in his ankle after he fell during the basketball game and could not walk.
他在籃球比賽中跌倒後，腳踝感到劇痛，無法走路。
an acute sense of smell: Dogs have an acute sense of smell, so the police use them to find drugs and missing people.
狗有敏銳的嗅覺，所以警方利用牠們尋找毒品和失蹤人口。
acute embarrassment: To my acute embarrassment, I called my teacher "Mom" in front of the whole class.
我在全班面前叫老師「媽媽」，讓我極度尷尬。
an acute angle: In math class, we learned that an acute angle is any angle smaller than ninety degrees.
在數學課上，我們學到銳角是任何小於九十度的角。
adequate for one's needs: The small apartment is adequate for my needs, since I live alone and work most of the day.
這間小公寓足以滿足我的需求，因為我獨居而且白天大部分時間都在工作。
an adequate supply of: Make sure you bring an adequate supply of water when you go hiking in the mountains in summer.
夏天去山裡健行時，務必帶充足的水。
adequate preparation: Without adequate preparation, it is hard to do well on the college entrance exam.
沒有充分的準備，很難在大學入學考試中考好。
barely adequate: The hotel room was barely adequate, with a tiny bed and no window, but it was all we could afford.
那間飯店房間勉強夠用，床很小又沒有窗戶，但那是我們唯一負擔得起的。
administrative costs: The charity tries to keep its administrative costs low so that most donations go directly to poor children.
這個慈善機構盡量壓低行政費用，讓大部分捐款直接用在貧童身上。
administrative staff: The school's administrative staff handle student records, so please ask them if you need a copy of your grades.
學校的行政人員負責處理學生資料，所以需要成績單影本請找他們。
an administrative error: Because of an administrative error, my name was left off the list of students who passed the exam.
由於行政疏失，我的名字沒有出現在考試通過的學生名單上。
an admirable achievement: Finishing the marathon after a serious knee injury was an admirable achievement for the old runner.
在膝蓋嚴重受傷後跑完馬拉松，對這位年長跑者來說是令人欽佩的成就。
show admirable restraint: Even when the angry customer shouted at him, the waiter showed admirable restraint and stayed polite.
即使憤怒的顧客對他大吼，服務生仍展現令人敬佩的自制，保持禮貌。
